summary: Velo3D, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a sales agreement with Needham & Company, Cantor Fitzgerald, and Craig-Hallum Capital Group for an at-the-market offering of up to $100 million of its common stock under an existing effective shelf registration statement. The filing does not announce a special situation transaction; it is a routine capital markets engagement. The structure and terms described are standard for an ATM program, with no change of control, restructuring, or strategic review involved.
